title: VIVOHOME Stand Mixer, 660W 10 Speed 6 Quart Tilt-Head Kitchen Electric Food Mixer with Beater, Dough Hook, Wire Whip and Egg Separator, Red
reviews: I have used this for about a month now. The first one I ordered arrived with a broken splash lid. Amazon customer service sent me a whole replacement identical product the next day. I just had to take the extra to the UPS store to send back. This mixer works like a dream. I do wish the attachments could go into the dishwasher for ease of cleaning. I also am jealous of the name brand mixer having more attachments available. I am not sure if any of these "universal" aftermarket attachments wll work. The mixer itself is a breeze to wipe down and clean. The splash guard was kind of unnecessary so far. It is hard to put on and use anyway but it does work to prevent splatter. I have noticed a kind of extremely slight smell of the motor when it is working. Not a burning smell but almost. I hope the motor is good. I have needed to use a spatula to scrape down the sides but it incorporates the ingredients fully. There is usually just a dusting of four I like to scrape into my batter. It mixes very well. I am looking forward to making some yeast rolls soon! So far I have made meringue cookies, quick bread, cookies and muffins.

I love it, been baking nonstop since early November. It doesn't take up much space. Not too loud, easy to use, personally it's a great value. It's a great little starter mixer until I move & have more kitchen space for the kitchen aid mixer

I bought this because I wanted a pink mixer to match my kitchen. I had a black kitchen aide mixer but it’s huge and I can’t leave it on my counter. I figured I would try this because it wasn’t that expensive, so nothing to lose. I’m so glad that I did! I’ve made bread, muffins, and rolls in this mixer and it never missed a beat! No jumping or struggling, it is pleasantly sweet looking in pink and super functional. Absolutely worth the money and having all the tools come with it just sweetens the deal. Pleasantly surprised by how much I love this!

I bought this so my wife will make bread. I have gotten zero breads. I want BREADS!!. I keep getting I need this I need that blah blah I want bread. I will keep buying things till I get bread. P.s. This thing is pretty cool. Works well. only complain is size. It takes up alot of space. I'm No size queen tho.

So far, so good! Made a large batch of Chocolate Chip Cookies. Didn't strain at all...plenty of power and I probably didn't have above mid-speed. The large bowl is great..nothing flying out, even without using shield. It's a secondary mixer I'm leaving in a winter rental. I like it!

I had been wanting a stand mixer for a long time, but could not reconcile spending at least $500 for the gold standard KitchenAid. I ordered this one in pink and I’m so glad that I did! I refer to it as my Barbie mixer lol but it does work really well, doing everything that I would imagine the KitchenAid does. I especially like the splash guard; no more flour or sugar sprinkled all over the kitchen. The bowl is a perfect size and cleans up very easily. This is a great buy!
Gift for granddaughter. She loves it as her first kitchen aide
